name: Create a class and manage its student roster
covers: More menu closes when tapping outside
More menu charcoal trigger and blue menu with white text
description: Verifies a class and student roster can be created, changed, and retained.
steps: Add class CLASS 8AAD with a teacher and dates
Open More on the class card, verify its charcoal button and blue menu with white text, then tap outside the menu
Open its Students list and add a student named Amina
Edit the student and refresh the page
expected: The More menu closes on an outside tap. The menu trigger is charcoal, and the menu has a blue background with white text. The class and edited student remain visible after refresh.

name: Record attendance and manage session history
covers: Present, Absent, and Late status cycling
Present is green and Absent is red
description: Uses the attendance history and entry screens to create and manage daily records.
steps: Create a class and add two students
Open the class Attendance page and press Add Att
Check the students start as Absent, change one to Present and one to Late, enter a remark, and Save
Refresh the page
expected: Present rows are green and Absent rows are red. The new record appears at the top with date, lecture, and attendance count. Edit retains the statuses and remark; Copy opens a new date with copied statuses; Delete removes the record after confirmation.

name: Financial lists only created classes and supports manual Paid marking
description: Checks Financial is class scoped and lets the user manually mark a class member as paid.
steps: Create a class and add two students
Open Financial and select that class
Mark one student paid and refresh
expected: Financial shows the selected class roster, displays PAID beside the marked student, and keeps the other student unpaid.

name: Generate filtered attendance register and report
covers: checkbox ordering by name, registration number, or attendance
late attendance weighted at half a day
attendance summary XLSX with only student name and attendance percentage
description: Uses a date range and report options to generate Excel attendance files.
steps: Create a class with students and record five attendance days, including three Present, one Late, and one Absent for a student
Open Class Reports, choose the class, select the inclusive date range, and choose Attendance % with ascending order
Download the register and summary, then open both files in WPS Office
expected: Both XLSX files open in WPS. The summary contains exactly Student Name and Attendance % columns and one row per selected student, with no class, date, registration, gender, or day-count fields. The register keeps its daily attendance details. The student with three Present, one Late, and one Absent has 70%; a student with three Present and two Absent has 60%. Days without a saved register are excluded.

name: Capitalize and export student roster
covers: column widths sized to their contents
description: Saves names in uppercase and exports the student roster as a WPS-compatible Excel workbook.
steps: Add a student and parent using mixed-case names, and set Date of Admission
Add another student while leaving guardian and phone fields empty, then save
Use Download Excel from the roster
Use Download Students from Classes to export all classes and open the workbook in WPS Office
expected: The first student's name and parent name are saved in uppercase; the second student saves without guardian or phone details and keeps the auto-generated registration number. XLSX downloads open in WPS with bold column headers and widths that show each header and cell value without clipping.

name: Back up and restore the school database
description: Verifies the complete local school database can be exported and restored.
steps: Create a class, a student, an attendance mark, and a Paid mark
Export a backup from Backup / Restore
Restore the backup and confirm replacement
expected: The restored database retains the class, roster, attendance, and PAID label. The page warns that backup data is plain text and must be kept private. Malformed files show 'Invalid backup file.' without changing the app.

name: Reject unsafe and malformed backup data
covers: Content Security Policy blocks inline scripts
description: Checks invalid local and restored data cannot break the app or execute HTML/JavaScript.
steps: Try restoring a malformed JSON file and a file larger than 5 MB
Restore a structurally valid backup containing in a student name, id, date, and attendance status
Load a malformed school object in localStorage and reload the app
expected: Malformed or oversized files show 'Invalid backup file.' without changing the current data. Invalid store entries are discarded or rejected, the app falls back to the blank store when needed, and the HTML payload never executes.
